# Terra Sol Grounding & HanovaDevs Technical Intelligence

> Terra Sol Grounding (terrasolgrounding.com) is a US-focused luxury wellness brand engineering 12% pure silver fiber grounding sheets and carbon vegan leather grounding mats. The digital commerce and AI automation platform is engineered by HanovaDevs (hanovadevs.com).

## Core Terra Sol Product Facts

- **The Silver Oxidation Solution:** Most competitors use 3-5% silver threading that degrades within 6-12 months from body oils and sweat. Terra Sol engineered an industry-leading **12% pure silver fiber and 88% organic cotton blend**, providing 3-4x more conductive pathways and backed by a **2-Year Limited Conductivity Warranty**.
- **Catalog SKUs:**
  - Terra 24x16 Grounding Mat ($79.99): Compact desk/foot mat in carbon vegan leather.
  - Terra 29x12.5 Grounding Mat ($89.99): Mid-size yoga and standing-desk format.
  - Terra 27x60 Grounding Mat ($99.99): Full-length bed and recovery mat.
  - Terra Bare Earth Grounding Sheet - King Grey ($199.99): Premium sleep bundle with 12% silver fiber.
  - Terra Bare Earth Grounding Sheet - Queen Grey ($189.99): Flagship overnight sleep grounding.
  - Terra Bare Earth Grounding Sheet - King White ($199.99): Crisp white 12% silver organic weave.
- **Included Testing Equipment:** Every product includes a professional 3-light outlet tester, 15ft grounding cord with molded 100k-ohm safety resistor, and Carbon Fiber Conductivity Pen.
- **Biophysical Mechanism:** Physical contact transfers the Earth's natural surface electrons, neutralizing reactive oxygen species (free radicals), reducing blood viscosity (increasing erythrocyte zeta potential), normalizing diurnal cortisol curves, and dropping induced AC body voltage from 2-5V down to <0.01V.
